boundary: HAL buffer frame host timestamps; not physical ADC/DAC measurement

analysis.boundary: Difference between driver-reported host timestamps of corresponding audio frames in the named callback buffers. Not an ADC/DAC, acoustic, or original application-to-PC-Tap latency measurement.
analysis.arrival_boundary: Output callback entry minus input callback entry for matched frames; includes callback block phase and is not output completion or presentation latency.
analysis.method: independent timestamp-rate fit, common host-time grid, per-channel normalized cross-correlation
notes: fit_snr_db is delayed linear-fit signal/residual ratio, not a hardware noise-floor measurement.
Fractional peak interpolation improves the estimate; it does not establish sub-sample hardware accuracy.
No device/stream latency or FIFO/SRC estimate is added to measured timestamp differences.
Only accepted windows contribute to summaries; rejected windows remain in the report.

windows.reason: weak correlation (unrelated audio, noise, or FX transformation); poor delayed-signal fit
